input.prompt: Create a premium modern project management dashboard for a software development team. Include project progress, task statistics, team members, upcoming deadlines, project activity, and interactive task filtering.

output.message: A premium interactive project management dashboard for a software development team.
output.code:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

    <title>TaskFlow — Project Management Dashboard</title>

    <style>
        :root {
            --primary: #5b5bd6;
            --primary-hover: #4747b8;
            --accent: #8b5cf6;

            --background: #f6f7fb;
            --surface: #ffffff;
            --surface-secondary: #f1f2f7;

            --text-primary: #171821;
            --text-secondary: #737789;

            --border: #e7e8ee;

            --success: #16a34a;
            --warning: #f59e0b;
            --danger: #ef4444;
            --info: #2563eb;

            --sidebar-width: 260px;

            --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04);
            --shadow-md: 0 12px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);

            --radius-sm: 10px;
            --radius-md: 16px;
            --radius-lg: 22px;
        }

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family:
                Inter,
                -apple-system,
                BlinkMacSystemFont,
                "Segoe UI",
                sans-serif;

            background: var(--background);
            color: var(--text-primary);
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        button,
        input {
            font: inherit;
        }

        button {
            border: none;
            cursor: pointer;
        }

        /* =========================
           SIDEBAR
        ========================= */

        .sidebar {
            width: var(--sidebar-width);
            min-height: 100vh;

            position: fixed;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;

            background: var(--surface);
            border-right: 1px solid var(--border);

            padding: 24px 16px;

            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;

            z-index: 100;
            transition: transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .brand {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;

            padding: 0 10px;
            margin-bottom: 40px;

            font-size: 20px;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .brand-icon {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;

            display: grid;
            place-items: center;

            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;

            border-radius: 12px;
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .nav-section {
            margin-bottom: 28px;
        }

        .nav-label {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;

            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.08em;

            padding: 0 12px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }

        .nav-item {
            width: 100%;

            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;

            padding: 12px;

            background: transparent;
            color: var(--text-secondary);

            border-radius: var(--radius-sm);

            text-align: left;

            transition:
                background 0.2s ease,
                color 0.2s ease,
                transform 0.2s ease;

            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .nav-item:hover {
            background: var(--surface-secondary);
            color: var(--text-primary);
        }

        .nav-item.active {
            background: rgba(91, 91, 214, 0.1);
            color: var(--primary);
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .nav-icon {
            width: 22px;
            text-align: center;
        }

        .sidebar-bottom {
            margin-top: auto;
        }

        .upgrade-card {
            background: linear-gradient(
                135deg,
                var(--primary),
                var(--accent)
            );

            color: white;

            padding: 18px;
            border-radius: var(--radius-md);

            margin-bottom: 18px;
        }

        .upgrade-card h4 {
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .upgrade-card p {
            font-size: 13px;
            opacity: 0.85;
            line-height: 1.5;
            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }

        .upgrade-btn {
            width: 100%;
            padding: 10px;

            border-radius: 9px;

            background: white;
            color: var(--primary);

            font-weight: 700;
        }

        /* =========================
           MAIN
        ========================= */

        .main {
            margin-left: var(--sidebar-width);
            min-height: 100vh;
        }

        .topbar {
            height: 80px;

            background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.9);

            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);

            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;

            padding: 0 40px;

            position: sticky;
            top: 0;

            z-index: 50;

            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .menu-btn {
            display: none;

            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;

            border-radius: 10px;

            background: var(--surface-secondary);
        }

        .search {
            position: relative;
            width: 320px;
        }

        .search input {
            width: 100%;

            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            background: var(--background);

            border-radius: 10px;

            padding: 11px 16px 11px 40px;

            outline: none;

            transition: border 0.2s ease;
        }

        .search input:focus {
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .search-icon {
            position: absolute;

            left: 14px;
            top: 50%;

            transform: translateY(-50%);

            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .topbar-right {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 18px;
        }

        .icon-btn {
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            background: var(--surface-secondary);
            color: var(--text-primary);

            position: relative;
        }

        .notification-dot {
            position: absolute;

            width: 8px;
            height: 8px;

            background: var(--danger);

            border-radius: 50%;

            top: 8px;
            right: 9px;

            border: 2px solid white;
        }

        .profile {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .avatar {
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            display: grid;
            place-items: center;

            background: #dbeafe;
            color: #1d4ed8;

            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .profile-info strong {
            display: block;
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .profile-info span {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        /* =========================
           CONTENT
        ========================= */

        .content {
            padding: 40px;
            max-width: 1600px;
            margin: auto;
        }

        .page-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: flex-start;
            justify-content: space-between;

            gap: 20px;

            margin-bottom: 32px;
        }

        .page-header h1 {
            font-size: 32px;
            letter-spacing: -0.03em;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .page-header p {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .primary-btn {
            background: var(--primary);
            color: white;

            padding: 12px 18px;

            border-radius: 10px;

            font-weight: 700;

            transition:
                background 0.2s ease,
                transform 0.2s ease,
                box-shadow 0.2s ease;
        }

        .primary-btn:hover {
            background: var(--primary-hover);
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        /* =========================
           METRICS
        ========================= */

        .metrics-grid {
            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr));

            gap: 20px;

            margin-bottom: 28px;
        }

        .metric-card {
            background: var(--surface);

            border: 1px solid var(--border);

            border-radius: var(--radius-md);

            padding: 22px;

            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);

            transition:
                transform 0.2s ease,
                box-shadow 0.2s ease;
        }

        .metric-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);
            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);
        }

        .metric-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;

            margin-bottom: 18px;
        }

        .metric-label {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 14px;
        }

        .metric-icon {
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;

            display: grid;
            place-items: center;

            border-radius: 12px;

            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .purple {
            background: rgba(91, 91, 214, 0.12);
            color: var(--primary);
        }

        .green {
            background: rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.12);
            color: var(--success);
        }

        .orange {
            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12);
            color: var(--warning);
        }

        .blue {
            background: rgba(37, 99, 235, 0.12);
            color: var(--info);
        }

        .metric-value {
            font-size: 30px;
            font-weight: 800;
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .metric-change {
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .positive {
            color: var(--success);
        }

        .warning-text {
            color: var(--warning);
        }

        /* =========================
           MAIN GRID
        ========================= */

        .dashboard-grid {
            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                minmax(0, 1.7fr)
                minmax(320px, 0.9fr);

            gap: 28px;

            margin-bottom: 28px;
        }

        .card {
            background: var(--surface);

            border: 1px solid var(--border);

            border-radius: var(--radius-md);

            padding: 24px;

            box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
        }

        .card-header {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: space-between;

            margin-bottom: 24px;
        }

        .card-header h2 {
            font-size: 18px;
        }

        .text-btn {
            background: transparent;
            color: var(--primary);

            font-weight: 700;
        }

        /* =========================
           PROJECTS
        ========================= */

        .project-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 18px;
        }

        .project-item {
            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 14px;

            padding: 18px;

            transition:
                border 0.2s ease,
                transform 0.2s ease;
        }

        .project-item:hover {
            border-color: rgba(91, 91, 214, 0.5);
            transform: translateY(-2px);
        }

        .project-top {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            gap: 16px;

            margin-bottom: 16px;
        }

        .project-name {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 12px;
        }

        .project-color {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            border-radius: 50%;
        }

        .color-one {
            background: var(--primary);
        }

        .color-two {
            background: var(--success);
        }

        .color-three {
            background: var(--warning);
        }

        .project-name h3 {
            font-size: 15px;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .project-name p {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .project-percent {
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .progress-track {
            width: 100%;
            height: 8px;

            background: var(--surface-secondary);
            border-radius: 100px;

            overflow: hidden;

            margin-bottom: 14px;
        }

        .progress-bar {
            height: 100%;
            border-radius: inherit;

            transition: width 0.8s ease;
        }

        .progress-one {
            width: 78%;
            background: var(--primary);
        }

        .progress-two {
            width: 52%;
            background: var(--success);
        }

        .progress-three {
            width: 34%;
            background: var(--warning);
        }

        .project-footer {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;

            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .team {
            display: flex;
        }

        .team-avatar {
            width: 28px;
            height: 28px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            display: grid;
            place-items: center;

            font-size: 10px;
            font-weight: 800;

            border: 2px solid white;

            margin-left: -8px;
        }

        .team-avatar:first-child {
            margin-left: 0;
        }

        /* =========================
           DEADLINES
        ========================= */

        .deadline-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 4px;
        }

        .deadline-item {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 14px;

            padding: 14px 0;

            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        .deadline-item:last-child {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .deadline-date {
            width: 46px;
            height: 50px;

            border-radius: 10px;

            background: var(--surface-secondary);

            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;

            flex-shrink: 0;
        }

        .deadline-date strong {
            font-size: 16px;
        }

        .deadline-date span {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .deadline-info {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .deadline-info h4 {
            font-size: 14px;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .deadline-info p {
            font-size: 12px;
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .status {
            padding: 5px 9px;
            border-radius: 100px;

            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .status-urgent {
            color: var(--danger);
            background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1);
        }

        .status-soon {
            color: #b45309;
            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12);
        }

        .status-normal {
            color: var(--success);
            background: rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.1);
        }

        /* =========================
           ACTIVITY
        ========================= */

        .activity-card {
            margin-bottom: 30px;
        }

        .activity-list {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 22px;
        }

        .activity-item {
            display: flex;
            gap: 14px;
        }

        .activity-avatar {
            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;

            flex-shrink: 0;

            border-radius: 50%;

            display: grid;
            place-items: center;

            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .activity-content {
            flex: 1;
        }

        .activity-content p {
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 1.5;

            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }

        .activity-content strong {
            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .activity-time {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            font-size: 12px;
        }

        /* =========================
           TASK TABLE
        ========================= */

        .tasks-table-wrapper {
            overflow-x: auto;
        }

        table {
            width: 100%;
            border-collapse: collapse;
            min-width: 700px;
        }

        th {
            text-align: left;

            color: var(--text-secondary);

            font-size: 12px;

            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.04em;

            padding: 12px 14px;

            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        td {
            padding: 16px 14px;

            font-size: 14px;

            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
        }

        tr:last-child td {
            border-bottom: none;
        }

        .task-name {
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .task-project {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
        }

        .priority {
            padding: 5px 9px;
            border-radius: 100px;

            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .priority-high {
            background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1);
            color: var(--danger);
        }

        .priority-medium {
            background: rgba(245, 158, 11, 0.12);
            color: #b45309;
        }

        .priority-low {
            background: rgba(22, 163, 74, 0.1);
            color: var(--success);
        }

        /* =========================
           MODAL
        ========================= */

        .modal-overlay {
            position: fixed;

            inset: 0;

            background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.45);

            display: none;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;

            padding: 20px;

            z-index: 300;
        }

        .modal-overlay.show {
            display: flex;
        }

        .modal {
            width: 100%;
            max-width: 460px;

            background: var(--surface);

            border-radius: var(--radius-lg);

            padding: 28px;

            box-shadow: var(--shadow-md);

            animation: modalIn 0.25s ease;
        }

        @keyframes modalIn {
            from {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translateY(15px) scale(0.98);
            }

            to {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translateY(0) scale(1);
            }
        }

        .modal h2 {
            margin-bottom: 8px;
        }

        .modal p {
            color: var(--text-secondary);
            margin-bottom: 20px;
        }

        .modal input {
            width: 100%;

            padding: 12px 14px;

            border: 1px solid var(--border);
            border-radius: 10px;

            outline: none;

            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }

        .modal input:focus {
            border-color: var(--primary);
        }

        .modal-actions {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: flex-end;
            gap: 10px;

            margin-top: 14px;
        }

        .secondary-btn {
            padding: 11px 16px;

            background: var(--surface-secondary);

            border-radius: 10px;

            color: var(--text-primary);

            font-weight: 700;
        }

        /* =========================
           MOBILE
        ========================= */

        .sidebar-overlay {
            display: none;

            position: fixed;
            inset: 0;

            background: rgba(15, 23, 42, 0.4);

            z-index: 90;
        }

        @media (max-width: 1100px) {
            .metrics-grid {
                grid-template-columns:
                    repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr));
            }

            .dashboard-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 850px) {
            .sidebar {
                transform: translateX(-100%);
            }

            .sidebar.open {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }

            .sidebar-overlay.show {
                display: block;
            }

            .main {
                margin-left: 0;
            }

            .menu-btn {
                display: block;
            }

            .topbar {
                padding: 0 20px;
            }

            .search {
                width: 100%;
                max-width: 280px;
            }

            .content {
                padding: 28px 20px;
            }
        }

        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .topbar {
                gap: 12px;
            }

            .search {
                display: none;
            }

            .profile-info {
                display: none;
            }

            .page-header {
                flex-direction: column;
            }

            .metrics-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .page-header h1 {
                font-size: 27px;
            }

            .project-top {
                flex-direction: column;
            }

            .deadline-item {
                align-items: flex-start;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>

<body>

    <!-- MOBILE OVERLAY -->

    <div
        class="sidebar-overlay"
        id="sidebarOverlay">
    </div>


    <!-- SIDEBAR -->

    <aside
        class="sidebar"
        id="sidebar">

        <div class="brand">

            <div class="brand-icon">
                ✓
            </div>

            <span>
                TaskFlow
            </span>

        </div>


        <div class="nav-section">

            <div class="nav-label">
                Workspace
            </div>

            <button
                class="nav-item active"
                data-view="dashboard">

                <span class="nav-icon">
                    ▦
                </span>

                Dashboard

            </button>

            <button
                class="nav-item"
                data-view="projects">

                <span class="nav-icon">
                    ◈
                </span>

                Projects

            </button>

            <button
                class="nav-item"
                data-view="tasks">

                <span class="nav-icon">
                    ✓
                </span>

                My Tasks

            </button>

            <button
                class="nav-item"
                data-view="calendar">

                <span class="nav-icon">
                    □
                </span>

                Calendar

            </button>

        </div>


        <div class="nav-section">

            <div class="nav-label">
                Management
            </div>

            <button
                class="nav-item"
                data-view="team">

                <span class="nav-icon">
                    ♙
                </span>

                Team

            </button>

            <button
                class="nav-item"
                data-view="reports">

                <span class="nav-icon">
                    ◔
                </span>

                Reports

            </button>

            <button
                class="nav-item"
                data-view="settings">

                <span class="nav-icon">
                    ⚙
                </span>

                Settings

            </button>

        </div>


        <div class="sidebar-bottom">

            <div class="upgrade-card">

                <h4>
                    Upgrade your workspace
                </h4>

                <p>
                    Unlock unlimited projects and advanced reporting.
                </p>

                <button
                    class="upgrade-btn"
                    id="upgradeBtn">

                    Upgrade Plan

                </button>

            </div>


            <button class="nav-item">

                <span class="nav-icon">
                    ?
                </span>

                Help & Support

            </button>

        </div>

    </aside>


    <!-- MAIN -->

    <main class="main">


        <!-- TOPBAR -->

        <header class="topbar">

            <button
                class="menu-btn"
                id="menuBtn">

                ☰

            </button>


            <div class="search">

                <span class="search-icon">
                    ⌕
                </span>

                <input
                    type="text"
                    id="searchInput"
                    placeholder="Search projects and tasks">

            </div>


            <div class="topbar-right">

                <button
                    class="icon-btn"
                    id="notificationBtn"
                    aria-label="Notifications">

                    ♧

                    <span
                        class="notification-dot">
                    </span>

                </button>


                <div class="profile">

                    <div class="avatar">
                        LC
                    </div>

                    <div class="profile-info">

                        <strong>
                            Alex Morgan
                        </strong>

                        <span>
                            Project Manager
                        </span>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </div>

        </header>


        <!-- CONTENT -->

        <div class="content">


            <!-- PAGE HEADER -->

            <div class="page-header">

                <div>

                    <h1>
                        Good morning, Alex
                    </h1>

                    <p>
                        Here is what is happening across your projects today.
                    </p>

                </div>


                <button
                    class="primary-btn"
                    id="newProjectBtn">

                    + New Project

                </button>

            </div>


            <!-- METRICS -->

            <section class="metrics-grid">


                <article class="metric-card">

                    <div class="metric-top">

                        <span class="metric-label">
                            Active Projects
                        </span>

                        <div class="metric-icon purple">
                            ◈
                        </div>

                    </div>

                    <div class="metric-value">
                        12
                    </div>

                    <div class="metric-change positive">
                        ↑ 8.4% from last month
                    </div>

                </article>


                <article class="metric-card">

                    <div class="metric-top">

                        <span class="metric-label">
                            Tasks Completed
                        </span>

                        <div class="metric-icon green">
                            ✓
                        </div>

                    </div>

                    <div class="metric-value">

    <div
        class="modal-overlay"
        id="projectModal">

        <div class="modal">

            <h2>
                Create New Project
            </h2>

            <p>
                Add a project to your workspace.
            </p>

            <input
                type="text"
                id="projectNameInput"
                placeholder="Project name">

            <div class="modal-actions">

                <button
                    class="secondary-btn"
                    id="cancelProjectBtn">

                    Cancel

                </button>

                <button
                    class="primary-btn"
                    id="createProjectBtn">

                    Create Project

                </button>

            </div>

        </div>

    </div>


    <script>

        /* =========================
           SIDEBAR
        ========================= */

        const menuBtn =
            document.getElementById("menuBtn");

        const sidebar =
            document.getElementById("sidebar");

        const sidebarOverlay =
            document.getElementById("sidebarOverlay");


        function closeSidebar() {

            sidebar.classList.remove("open");

            sidebarOverlay.classList.remove("show");

        }


        menuBtn.addEventListener(
            "click",
            () => {

                sidebar.classList.toggle("open");

                sidebarOverlay.classList.toggle("show");

            }
        );


        sidebarOverlay.addEventListener(
            "click",
            closeSidebar
        );


        /* =========================
           NAVIGATION
        ========================= */

        const navItems =
            document.querySelectorAll(".nav-item[data-view]");


        navItems.forEach(
            (item) => {

                item.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    () => {

                        navItems.forEach(
                            (nav) =>
                                nav.classList.remove("active")
                        );

                        item.classList.add("active");

                        document.querySelector("h1").textContent =
                            item.textContent.trim();

                        closeSidebar();

                    }
                );

            }
        );


        /* =========================
           NEW PROJECT MODAL
        ========================= */

        const newProjectBtn =
            document.getElementById("newProjectBtn");

        const projectModal =
            document.getElementById("projectModal");

        const cancelProjectBtn =
            document.getElementById("cancelProjectBtn");

        const createProjectBtn =
            document.getElementById("createProjectBtn");

        const projectNameInput =
            document.getElementById("projectNameInput");

        const projectList =
            document.getElementById("projectList");


        newProjectBtn.addEventListener(
            "click",
            () => {

                projectModal.classList.add("show");

                projectNameInput.focus();

            }
        );


        cancelProjectBtn.addEventListener(
            "click",
            () => {

                projectModal.classList.remove("show");

                projectNameInput.value = "";

            }
        );


        projectModal.addEventListener(
            "click",
            (event) => {

                if (
                    event.target === projectModal
                ) {

                    projectModal.classList.remove("show");

                }

            }
        );


        createProjectBtn.addEventListener(
            "click",
            () => {

                const projectName =
                    projectNameInput.value.trim();

                if (!projectName) {

                    projectNameInput.focus();

                    return;

                }


                const projectElement =
                    document.createElement("div");

                projectElement.className =
                    "project-item";


                projectElement.innerHTML = `

                    <div class="project-top">

                        <div class="project-name">

                            <span
                                class="project-color color-one">
                            </span>

                            <div>

                                <h3>
                                    ${projectName}
                                </h3>

                                <p>
                                    0 of 0 tasks completed
                                </p>

                            </div>

                        </div>

                        <span class="project-percent">
                            0%
                        </span>

                    </div>

                    <div class="progress-track">

                        <div
                            class="progress-bar"
                            style="
                                width:0%;
                                background:var(--primary);
                            ">
                        </div>

                    </div>

                    <div class="project-footer">

                        <span>
                            New project
                        </span>

                        <span>
                            Just created
                        </span>

                    </div>

                `;


                projectList.prepend(
                    projectElement
                );


                projectModal.classList.remove("show");

                projectNameInput.value = "";

            }
        );


        /* =========================
           SEARCH
        ========================= */

        const searchInput =
            document.getElementById("searchInput");


        searchInput.addEventListener(
            "input",
            () => {

                const searchTerm =
                    searchInput.value
                        .toLowerCase()
                        .trim();


                document
                    .querySelectorAll(
                        ".project-item"
                    )
                    .forEach(
                        (project) => {

                            const projectText =
                                project.textContent
                                    .toLowerCase();

                            project.style.display =
                                projectText.includes(searchTerm)
                                    ? ""
                                    : "none";

                        }
                    );


                document
                    .querySelectorAll(
                        "#taskTableBody tr"
                    )
                    .forEach(
                        (row) => {

                            const rowText =
                                row.textContent
                                    .toLowerCase();

                            row.style.display =
                                rowText.includes(searchTerm)
                                    ? ""
                                    : "none";

                        }
                    );

            }
        );


        /* =========================
           SORT TASKS
        ========================= */

        const sortTasksBtn =
            document.getElementById("sortTasksBtn");

        const taskTableBody =
            document.getElementById("taskTableBody");


        const priorityOrder = {
            High: 1,
            Medium: 2,
            Low: 3
        };


        sortTasksBtn.addEventListener(
            "click",
            () => {

                const rows =
                    Array.from(
                        taskTableBody.querySelectorAll("tr")
                    );


                rows.sort(
                    (a, b) => {

                        const priorityA =
                            a.children[2]
                                .textContent
                                .trim();

                        const priorityB =
                            b.children[2]
                                .textContent
                                .trim();


                        return (
                            priorityOrder[priorityA]
                            -
                            priorityOrder[priorityB]
                        );

                    }
                );


                rows.forEach(
                    (row) =>
                        taskTableBody.appendChild(row)
                );

            }
        );


        /* =========================
           NOTIFICATIONS
        ========================= */

        const notificationBtn =
            document.getElementById(
                "notificationBtn"
            );


        notificationBtn.addEventListener(
            "click",
            () => {

                alert(
                    "You have 3 new notifications."
                );

            }
        );


        /* =========================
           UPGRADE BUTTON
        ========================= */

        const upgradeBtn =
            document.getElementById(
                "upgradeBtn"
            );


        upgradeBtn.addEventListener(
            "click",
            () => {

                alert(
                    "Upgrade options would open here."
                );

            }
        );

    </script>
